gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Chunky, tall-lowercase College draws its curves as stout as its stems, with big open counters throughout. Noto Sans Oriya takes over in the text, a plain sans with generous gaps.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-osage: Loud and rod-straight, College sets the tone with thick, uniform strokes. Noto Sans Osage follows with inflated lowercase bowls, so a slightly larger body size would let those curves breathe.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-osmanya: Every curve in College is as thick as its straight stems, which gives the headings a blunt, confident look. And Noto Sans Osmanya adds wide, easy s shapes and a lowercase that towers over its capitals.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-pahawh-h: Stiff and sturdy, College keeps every stroke at one thickness. And Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong brings a high-set x-height and rounds that gap open like a cracked bangle.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-palmyren: Blocky and straight-edged, College hammers out constant strokes, while Noto Sans Palmyrene brings curves that stop short instead of closing in. A plain sans, compact in its ascenders.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin-: Authoritative College pushes its heavy, untapered strokes forward, and Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau answers with open-ended curves in a plain sans. Slightly larger body text would suit those curves.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Light and see-through, Noto Sans PhagsPa opens its letters wide and bumps gently up from small forms to capitals. Beneath College's ruler-straight headings, that plain sans reads as a softer voice.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-phoenici: Noto Sans Phoenician is a plain sans with s curves that open wide at both ends and a generous lowercase height. College counters it with zero modulation in the line.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-psalter-: Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi gives the text gaping mouths on its e and capitals that barely rise above the lowercase. Under College's rod-built headings, a long page would feel approachable and unhurried.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Bent steel rod, bold and tall: that is College. It handles loud headings best, while Noto Sans Rejang does its best work in the text, with wide porthole counters and clear open gaps in c, e, s and a.
